- **A boolean flag is validated while the command line is parsed, before any command runs.** `bob onboard`'s `--dry-run`, `--no-flair`, `--force` and `--no-interactive`, and `bob run`'s `--interactive`, are on when written bare or as `=true`, off as `=false`, and every other spelling (`--dry-run=yes`, `--dry-run=1`, an empty `--dry-run=`, or the space form `--force false`) is a usage error with exit code 2; a bad spelling never runs the real command, and a boolean flag never takes the argument after it as its value (`bob onboard --dry-run testbot` keeps `testbot` as the name). (`test/shell/argv.test.ts`, `test/cli.test.ts`)
